content.short: daolama.co lending is the DAOLama NFT-backed borrowing flow for getting TON liquidity from NFTs.
content.description: daolama.co lending points to DAOLama's NFT lending workflow on TON. The product lets NFT holders use supported assets as collateral to receive TON, instead of only listing or selling the NFT outright. It belongs in NFT dapps because the core action starts from collection ownership and NFT collateral. For TON users, the value is access to digital collectibles and ownership workflows rather than fungible-token trading alone. daolama.co lending is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
